name: infragistics
description: Infragistics (UltraWinToolbars, UltraGrid, UltraTabbedMdi): fields and grids exposed, menus and toolbar buttons rarely raise Invoke, tab documents inside the main window.
note: Each editor is wrapped (txtName > txtName_EmbeddableTextBox); the wrappers are collapsed to one field. Message boxes expose their body as a read-only Edit named lblBody and are recorded as dialog events, not screens.
